executiveSummary.paragraph: Oxford Financial Ads is a modern digital advertising and online engagement platform where members can participate in various digital activities. These include captcha typing, data entry, video editing, graphic design, digital marketing, and other online-based tasks. Through these activities, members can connect with a global network and gain opportunities to work at an international level as well as real-world experience. Our goal is to create a professional, development-oriented, and growth-focused environment through skill development, global connectivity, and community-based collaboration. By participating here, members can build an international network and also gain access to various performance-based opportunities such as generation bonuses, group bonuses, company profit sharing, and different position achievements. This platform provides a structured opportunity for members to gain new experiences in the digital world, enhance their skills, and move forward financially.

whyChooseUs.subtitle: Explore a wide range of digital earning opportunities designed for your growth

whyChooseUs.dataEntryDesc: Members are provided with opportunities to participate in various activities related to information storage, data organization, and digital data management. Through these activities, opportunities are created to develop accuracy, professionalism, and technology-based skills.

Through these activities, opportunities are created to gain practical experience in international-standard design practices.
whyChooseUs.videoDesc: Opportunities are provided for members to participate in various activities for acquiring skills and professional development related to video editing, content development, and digital media management. Through gaining practical experience with a combination of modern technology and creativity, members can further refine their skills.
whyChooseUs.marketingDesc: Members are provided with opportunities to participate in various activities based on modern digital marketing, brand promotion, and online communication. Through these activities, practical skills development related to market analysis, audience engagement, and digital branding is created.
whyChooseUs.networkDesc: A professional global community has been built to connect individuals across different countries and cultures, enabling knowledge sharing and experience exchange on an international level. Based on skills and performance, members gain opportunities to work globally.
whyChooseUs.benefitsDesc: By joining Oxford Financial Ads, members gain access to a structured environment designed for professional and personal excellence with opportunities to develop advanced digital and professional skills.

founders.bottomText: Our founding team brings decades of combined experience in blockchain technology, artificial intelligence, and financial markets. Together, they've built Oxford Financial Ads to revolutionize decentralized trading.

Our goal is not only to create opportunities, but to establish a premium and positive ecosystem where members can unlock their full potential, achieve financial independence, and build a stable, prosperous, and successful future.

securityStandards.title: Institutional-Grade Security Standards for
securityStandards.description: We implement advanced multi-layer security protocols to ensure the highest level of protection for user data, digital assets, and transactions.
securityStandards.feature1Desc: At Oxford Financial Ads, your capital and campaign budgets remain under your direct control at all times. The platform never holds or locks your private keys or advertising funds, ensuring 100% transparency and asset security.
securityStandards.feature2Desc: Our advanced data-driven logic continuously adapts to market shifts to optimize every advertising campaign. This intelligent distribution ensures you achieve maximum returns, visibility, and profitability across all marketing cycles.
securityStandards.feature3Desc: To safeguard your investments against sudden market volatility, our system utilizes automated portfolio balancing and dynamic hedging strategies. It strategically distributes your ad spend to mitigate financial risks and guarantee platform integrity.
securityStandards.feature4Desc: Powered by an advanced high-speed infrastructure, your campaigns are deployed with microsecond-level precision. This ensures your target audience is engaged instantly, preventing you from missing high-value business opportunities or converting leads due to slow infrastructure.

corporateIntegrity.title: Built on the Principles of
corporateIntegrity.description: Built on the principles of trust, accountability, and ethical leadership, our organization is committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate transparency. Every aspect of our operations is guided by clear policies, responsible governance, and a dedication to open communication. We believe that lasting success is achieved through honesty, professionalism, and a strong commitment to protecting the interests of our members, partners, and stakeholders. Our transparent approach fosters confidence, credibility, and long-term relationships across our global network.
corporateIntegrity.card1Desc: Oxford Financial Ads: Registered corporate entity under Delaware General Corporation Law, providing legal clarity, compliance, and corporate client protection.
corporateIntegrity.card2Desc: Oxford Financial Ads: Standard Know Your Customer (KYC) and compliance procedures implemented in accordance with international advertising and financial regulatory frameworks.
corporateIntegrity.card3Desc: Oxford Financial Ads provides media buying, marketing, and advertising services. We do not provide financial advisory, legal planning, or guaranteed investment return services. Clients launch campaigns at their own discretion.
corporateIntegrity.card4Desc: Oxford Financial Ads: Advertising campaigns operate based on market dynamics and platform algorithms. Clients maintain full responsibility for their marketing decisions, budget allocations, and business outcomes.
corporateIntegrity.card5Desc: Oxford Financial Ads: Executing digital advertising campaigns involves market risks and fluctuations in audience engagement. Past campaign performance does not guarantee identical future results. Oxford Financial Ads uses advanced optimization models, but cannot guarantee specific sales or market conversion outcomes with absolute certainty. Clients should allocate marketing budgets based on their business goals and conduct independent market research before launching large-scale campaigns.
corporateIntegrity.footer: Committed to transparency, accountability, and ethical leadership worldwide

privacySecurity.title: Global-Standard Privacy:
privacySecurity.description: Oxford Financial Ads is built on a foundation of security, transparency, and user sovereignty. Our security architecture and compliance framework ensure your data and assets remain protected at all times.
privacySecurity.section1Desc: You maintain full control of your assets at all times. Oxford Financial Ads operates as a non-custodial platform where your funds remain in your wallet under your private key control. Smart contracts execute trades according to predefined parameters without third-party custody.
privacySecurity.section2Desc: All strategy executions are governed by audited smart contracts deployed on Arbitrum Layer-2. Automated protocols handle trade execution, position management, and rebalancing according to algorithmic parameters without human intervention or discretionary control.
privacySecurity.section3Desc: Your connected wallet retains withdrawal rights at all times. You can disconnect, withdraw partial or full balances, and exit strategies according to smart contract parameters. No lock-up periods or withdrawal restrictions beyond standard blockchain confirmation times.
privacySecurity.section4Desc: All projected performance scenarios are simulations based on historical data and algorithmic models. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile and involve substantial risk of loss. Only allocate capital you can afford to lose.
privacySecurity.feature1Desc: View the maximum possible profit per package — e.g., a $100 package progress bar shows 0 to $150.
privacySecurity.feature2Desc: Upgrade to a larger package anytime by purchasing the new package.
privacySecurity.feature3Desc: Each package has a badge or medal based on its name — e.g., $10 = 'Micro', $100,000 = 'Sovereign'.
privacySecurity.feature4Desc: When profit reaches 150%, the package card shows Expired and the withdrawal button is locked until a new package is purchased.
privacySecurity.legalNoticeDesc: Oxford Financial Ads provides algorithmic trading infrastructure and does not offer investment advice, financial planning, or portfolio management services. This platform is intended for sophisticated users who understand blockchain technology and cryptocurrency market risks. Participation constitutes acceptance of all inherent smart contract, market, technological, and regulatory risks. Consult independent legal, tax, and financial advisors before participating.

terms.title: Terms and
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using the Oxford Financial Ads platform
terms.noticeText1: By accessing or using Oxford Financial Ads, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Cryptocurrency trading involves substantial risk and may not be suitable for all investors. You should carefully consider your investment objectives and risk tolerance before using our platform.
terms.noticeText2: Oxford Financial Ads is a technology provider, not a financial advisory firm. Our AI logic is for data analysis only. Please conduct your own market research before investing.

sections.s1_c1: Market Volatility: Cryptocurrency and trading markets are highly volatile. Although we use AI technology to minimize risk, the value of investments may increase or decrease at any time.
sections.s1_c2: Capital Risk: Investors should understand that trading carries the risk of losing capital as well as making profits. Only surplus or discretionary funds should be invested.
sections.s1_c3: Past Performance: Past results do not guarantee future profits.
sections.s2_c1: Users must be legally adults according to their country laws (generally 18 years or older).
sections.s2_c2: Using the platform for illegal purposes or money laundering is strictly prohibited.
sections.s3_c1: Wallet Security: Oxford Financial Ads is a decentralized platform, and you are fully responsible for your wallet's private key and password. If lost, the company cannot recover your funds.
sections.s3_c2: Technical Limitations: Although we use Arbitrum and Offchain Labs' robust network, Oxford Financial Ads is not liable for blockchain network failures or network congestion.
sections.s4_c1: Processing Time: Deposits and withdrawals are generally instant, but may be delayed due to network traffic.
sections.s4_c2: Fees: Network gas fees and platform service charges may change over time and will be displayed during the transaction.
sections.s5_c1: If a user engages in scams, hacking attempts, or misuses platform logic, Oxford Financial Ads reserves the right to block the account without prior notice.
sections.s6_c1: Oxford Financial Ads reserves the right to update its rules, trading fees, or platform logic at any time. Major changes will be communicated to the global community in advance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.a1: Oxford Financial Ads is an AI-powered arbitrage trading platform that uses the Arbitrum network to generate profits by taking advantage of price differences across multiple exchanges with minimal risk.
faq.q2: What is the OFA token and how can I get it?
faq.a2: OFA is the native token of our ecosystem. By completing pre-registration, you will receive 100 free tokens, and you can earn additional bonus tokens for each successful referral.
faq.q3: Why are my OFA tokens locked?
faq.a3: Tokens are currently locked to maintain price stability and market value. According to our roadmap, they will be gradually unlocked and available for withdrawal after exchange listings.
faq.q4: Can I withdraw my daily trading profits (USDT)?
faq.a4: Yes. You can withdraw the daily ROI generated from your investment package at any time directly to your personal wallet.
faq.a5: We use the Arbitrum Layer-2 network, which is highly secure. Our AI bot does not trade based on speculation but uses mathematical data and analytics to execute trades, ensuring fund safety.
faq.q6: How does the referral commission system work?
faq.a6: We offer a powerful 5-level referral system. When someone joins through your referral, you will earn daily commissions along with bonus OFA tokens.

complianceSection.title: Security Architecture & Compliance
complianceSection.card1Desc: You maintain full control of your assets at all times. Oxford Financial Ads operates as a non-custodial platform where your funds remain in your wallet under your private key control. Smart contracts execute trades according to predefined parameters without third-party custody.
complianceSection.card2Desc: All strategy executions are governed by audited smart contracts deployed on Arbitrum Layer-2. Automated protocols handle trade execution, position management, and rebalancing according to algorithmic parameters without human intervention or discretionary control.
complianceSection.card3Desc: Your connected wallet retains withdrawal rights at all times. You can disconnect, withdraw partial or full balances, and exit strategies according to smart contract parameters. No lock-up periods or withdrawal restrictions beyond standard blockchain confirmation times.
complianceSection.card4Desc: All projected performance scenarios are simulations based on historical data and algorithmic models. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile and involve substantial risk of loss. Only allocate capital you can afford to lose.
complianceSection.feature1: Smart Selection: Users can view the maximum possible profit per package (e.g., a $100 package progress bar shows 0 to $150).
complianceSection.feature2: Auto-Upgrade Option: Users can upgrade to a larger package anytime by purchasing the new package.
complianceSection.feature3: Badge System: Each package has a badge or medal based on its name (e.g., $10 = 'Micro', $100,000 = 'Sovereign').
complianceSection.feature4: When a user's profit reaches 150%, the package card shows Expired and the withdrawal button is locked until a new package is purchased.
complianceSection.legalText: Oxford Financial Ads provides algorithmic trading infrastructure and does not offer investment advice, financial planning, or portfolio management services. This platform is intended for sophisticated users who understand blockchain technology and cryptocurrency market risks. Participation constitutes acceptance of all inherent smart contract, market, technological, and regulatory risks. Consult independent legal, tax, and financial advisors before participating.
